response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished developer with 15+ years of professional experience, he lacks several critical requirements for this role. Most significantly, native-level Japanese proficiency is explicitly required but entirely absent from his resume. His C programming experience is minimal (approximately 6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015), while this embedded systems role demands strong proficiency. His career has focused on web services, web applications, and data integration with no demonstrated expertise in network security, embedded networking, LAN-switch products, Linux kernel development, or security authentication systems. The combination of missing language skills, insufficient C background, and complete absence of domain-specific security and networking knowledge makes this a poor fit.
strengths: 15+ years of professional software development experience demonstrating ability to learn and deliver across multiple domains and programming paradigms
Strong emphasis on software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD, code quality, and maintainability throughout career
Some exposure to embedded systems and hardware control through robotics projects at Altom Consulting, showing openness to learning diverse technical domains
concerns: No native-level Japanese language proficiency, which is explicitly required for this position
Minimal C programming experience (approximately 6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015), while role requires strong proficiency in C for embedded UNIX systems
No demonstrated expertise in network security, embedded networking, LAN-switch products, security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X), or Linux kernel investigation and modification

key_factors.factor: Insufficient C programming experience for embedded development
No security or embedded networking domain expertise
